description: Raw-to-0..1 score normalization for the Tev1 decision endpoint. Identity passthrough when the endpoint already returns 0-1 floats; band-label mapping otherwise. Always persist score_raw + normalization_version next to normalized scores so Phase 2 can re-map without re-running the model.
note: Provisional until the /v1/systemone response shape is pinned on first successful call (see docs/tev1-contract.md).
